thread:
maria_ops: Heads up - vendor (NordicCompute) just emailed: H200 lead time bumped from ~6w to ~9w for our Q2 top-up. Also flagged 3 units as DOA in last consignment, vendor opened an RMA (47219).
liam_procurement: ccing @sanjay_vendor — we need confirmation: are replacements reserved or on backorder? any pricing delta?
sanjay_vendor: working this now. Depot photos incoming. DOA claim 47219 shows 3/32 failed POST. We can air-replace 2 units immediately, 1 will ship on the next production wave. Lead time bump is due to a capacitor shortage at the vendor fab.
emily_logistics: FYI customs note — FRA import control wants HS code recert + batch COA for this shipment batch. Could add 48-72h hold at FRA NCTS.
maria_ops: can we reroute the two air replacements to AMS to try to avoid the FRA hold?
sanjay_vendor: AMS currently has a 1-week backlog at the hub. FRA will be faster once documents clear. Tradeoff = customs hold vs forwarder queue time.
jack_finance: cost question — if vendor splits air vs sea, what's the surcharge? need a quick estimate for chargeback/PO amendment.
liam_procurement: rough numbers pls.
sanjay_vendor: air-replace surcharge per unit ~ $1.6k (expedited AWB + broker + pickup). If we consolidate via sea for the wave, no surcharge but ~9w delay.
maria_ops: ops preference is to keep dedicated EU pools online. Prioritize air for the 2 critical units to EU-dedicated racks.
emily_logistics: can we route through our emergency forwarder (AirFlex)? they do HS pre-clearance and will cut broker delay for +$350/AWB. That could reduce FRA hold risk.
maria_ops: yes, route 2 units via AirFlex. Please create the RMA tag and update deploy team with expected ETA.
opsbot: RMA ticket created: RMA-47219-EU. Link: https://redwood.example.com/rma/47219
liam_procurement: @sanjay_vendor please confirm AWB numbers and expected delivery windows for the air shipments so we can schedule depot intake.
sanjay_vendor: AWBs assigned: AF1234567890 and AF1234567891. ETA AMS door: 2024-05-22 14:00 UTC for both (pending customs clearance).
emily_logistics: noted. I'll pre-file HS docs and request door delivery to NL-dc-03.
maria_ops: also need a temporary loaner for the 1 pending replacement unit (to avoid capacity churn). Can vendor provide a 30-day loaner from spare pool?
sanjay_vendor: vendor can supply 1 loaner for up to 30 days, loaner forwarder fee billed separately.
jack_finance: loaner cost - do we have cap? $900/day is too high. propose approving up to $200/day; anything above needs Ops + Finance signoff.
maria_ops: ops can approve up to $400/day short-term. try vendor loaner first and bill to ops contingency.
liam_procurement: action items: 1) @sanjay_vendor confirm AWBs + invoice hold, 2) @emily_logistics file HS pre-clearance + door request, 3) @maria_ops request loaner via SparePool app, 4) @jack_finance prep chargeback estimate and PO amendment.
maria_ops: thanks — ping me ASAP when AWBs are uploaded to the portal.
emily_logistics: uploaded photos + COA to shared drive: https://redwood.example.com/drive/rma-47219-claim (depot photos + failing logs).
sanjay_vendor: confirmed, AWBs uploaded to vendor portal and RMA notes updated. Starting air pickup this afternoon.
maria_ops: :thumbsup:
